name: Energetic Burst
body:
School conjuration (healing) [good]; Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, paladin l

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The caster gains 10 temporary hit points and a +1 sacred bonus to all saving throws for the spell’s duration.
